body:
CANDIDATE (unprompted, W4(10) gap): 866e493 on branch m1/route, parent current main efce565. One source file and two test files, all embed-bench. This one came from reading vision.md rather than the board.

THE GAP. The vision's second question is: did recall follow presentation order, story-world time, causal structure, or another route involving jumps, reversals, revisits and compression? I checked what the bench actually measures and every single metric scores a unit INDEPENDENTLY - which anchor it hit, at what level, in what mode, with what facets. Nothing scored the STEP BETWEEN units. So a channel could place every unit on a plausible anchor, reconstruct a completely wrong journey through the story, and collect a clean scorecard from us.

The three clocks are not a defence: RecallSignature computes discourse chronology, compression and backward mass from the INFERRED result alone, with no gold to compare against. They describe the trajectory a channel produced; they cannot say whether it is the trajectory the person actually took. A channel that hallucinates a smooth chronology and one that correctly recovers a jumpy one are indistinguishable in that panel.

WHAT I ADDED. route:transition-direction - for each adjacent pair of units, compare the direction the GOLD route moved through the source with the direction the inferred MAP anchors moved. Three design decisions, each of which I think is the load-bearing one:
1. DIRECTION ONLY, never magnitude. A long jump forward and a short step forward are the same route decision; scoring the distance would measure something else and would punish a correct route across a sparsely-anchored stretch.
2. ABSTAIN when either side is not source-anchored. An external destination is a legitimate route - the model says so explicitly - but it is not a step THROUGH THE SOURCE, and scoring it as agreement or disagreement would be an invention. Missing, not zero, again.
3. The first unit of every case abstains: it has no predecessor, and a metric that scored it would be scoring nothing.

PROOF THAT IT IS A MEASUREMENT AND NOT DECORATION, since that is the trap I have fallen into twice tonight: a test asserts the metric actually FIRES on the full-recall case (the only WOG case with transitions), abstains on every single-unit paraphrase case, and abstains on the first unit everywhere. A metric that is always Missing would pass a naive "no failures" check forever. Mutations: replacing signum with the raw difference fails 1 test (it makes every unequal step disagree); scoring the first unit fails 8.

EVIDENCE at 866e493, clean pin, gate last from the committed tree: embedBench 42/42 (was 40), compileAll all three platforms, scalafmtCheckAll and scalafmtSbtCheck green.

WHAT THIS DOES NOT DO, stated so nobody reads more into it than is there: it scores direction agreement, not the full route - it will not distinguish a two-step reversal from a five-step one, and it says nothing about revisits or compression, which have their own clocks and no gold either. It is the first gold-compared route metric, not the last. And it connects to Law I6: this metric is exactly what an all-linear corpus cannot exercise, because on a linear source every gold direction is +1 and any channel that moves forward agrees by default. The metric and the anachrony slot need each other.
